workspace_label: Cantos Research Desk — retained Run 3 decision

case.title: A cost recommendation that survives a changed price
case.question: For this one graded coding workload, what does the retained result support at the dated list price, and what must change when that price changes?
three_minute_path: Read the dated recommendation and its measurement and billing limits.
Record a local review and issue the baseline snapshot.
Try an A/T0 price scenario, inspect the stale conclusion, recompute, review again and issue a successor while keeping the first delivery.

records.title: Run 3 report and correction
records.summary: Retained one-run-per-arm coding experiment on 2026-09-24. The reported cost comparison and later sanitizer correction are bounded to this workload and accounting.

limitations: One run per arm, no repeat or population reliability estimate.
Private preregistration is not an independent timestamp.
Reported list-price costs are not reconciled invoices.

records.title: Campaign method and funding disclosure
records.summary: The Hot Aisle arm used provider credit and is valued at undiscounted list price; the DigitalOcean H100 arm was self-funded.

limitations: Provider credit is disclosed; the displayed cost is valued at list price rather than cash spend.
Neither arm has a reconciled invoice in this case.

records.title: A/T0 measured accepted work
records.summary: Hot Aisle 1× MI300X: 8,622 scheduled and completed, 4,371 raw-correct and 4,336 accepted under the registered rule. Local native recomputation of retained bytes confirmed the accepted count.

window.basis: 2023 Azure LLM CODE arrivals replayed for one hour at factor 0.95; 542 EvalPlus tasks cycled. Cost window is separate.

grading.registered: Raw base-and-plus correctness, first token ≤1 second, completion ≤60 seconds, both timed from scheduled arrival.

posthoc.label: post-hoc correctness only; accepted intersection not recomputed

limitations: The post-hoc sanitizer regrade did not recompute deadline-qualified accepted closures; 4,336 remains the registered accepted count.
Grader-blind tasks remained in the denominator.

records.title: N/T0 retained comparator
records.summary: DigitalOcean 1× H100: 8,622 scheduled and completed, 4,329 raw-correct and 4,280 accepted. Local native recomputation of retained bytes confirmed the accepted count.

window.basis: Same task cycle and trace as A/T0; H100 vendor image and selected kernels differ.

grading.registered: Same raw base-and-plus and scheduled-arrival timing rule as A/T0.

limitations: H100 p50 was faster while its p99 TTFT was longer on this bursty trace; these are workload results, not general hardware properties.

records.title: A/T0 dated list price
records.summary: Hot Aisle MI300X list price was $2.99 per GPU-hour on the 2026-09-24 run. The 64.7-minute standalone equivalent is modeled from provisioning and the arm window, not an invoice.

data.billing: Provider-credit-funded run valued at undiscounted list price; invoices unreconciled.
data.scope: Modeled 64.7-minute A/T0 own-seat equivalent, including provisioning, request to release; not the actual shared-seat invoice.
limitations: Dated list price, no current quote or capacity check.
The shorter own-script window reports $0.72 per 1,000 and excludes modeled provisioning; this case uses the 64.7-minute own-seat equivalent instead.
Full shared seat was about $0.90 per 1,000 across smoke, A/T0 and A/T1; it is a different aggregation.

records.title: A/T0 modeled cost per accepted work
records.summary: The reported own-seat equivalent is $0.74 per 1,000 accepted at the dated $2.99/GPU-hour list price, using a 64.7-minute model window. The exact projection is computed by the native Compute owner.

limitations: Own-seat equivalent is modeled, not a reconciled invoice.
A price scenario changes this economic projection and leaves measured acceptance unchanged.

records.title: Comparator accounting and funding
records.summary: The H100 N/T0 result is reported at $1.20 per 1,000 accepted using its 69.8-minute closed request-to-release ledger and $4.41/GPU-hour list price. It is not the Hot Aisle shared-seat aggregate or a reconciled invoice.

data.funding: N/T0 self-funded; A/T0 provider-credit-funded but valued at list price
limitations: The A/T0 comparison uses a modeled own-seat equivalent, while N/T0 uses a closed ledger; label this accounting difference beside the figures.
No current price, availability or invoice reconciliation is established.

records.title: Use a dated, conditional cost reference
records.summary: At the 2026-09-24 list prices, A/T0's modeled $0.74 per 1,000 accepted is below N/T0's reported $1.20 for this one workload. Use it as a research reference; obtain fresh prices, capacity and full bills before placement.

conditions: The same Qwen3-Coder model revision, EvalPlus task cycle, Azure CODE trace and registered correctness/deadline rule are in scope; vendor images and selected kernels differ.
A/T0 is a modeled own-seat equivalent; N/T0 is a closed allocation ledger. Neither is a reconciled invoice.
One retained run per arm; no present capacity or general hardware ranking follows.
holds_unless: a fresh quote and capacity check supports the selected offer
full billing, failed starts and other charges are reconciled
the exact workload and acceptance rule still match the intended use
data.template: The A/T0 modeled own-seat estimate is {usd_per_1k_accepted} per 1,000 accepted at an assumed {rate}/GPU-hour, using the unchanged 4,336 accepted requests. The historical N/T0 reference remains $1.20 per 1,000 at its separate closed-ledger boundary. Reassess placement with fresh price, capacity and full billing before deciding.

boundaries.evidence: Retained one-run evidence, not a new benchmark. Local native recomputation confirmed 4,336 A/T0 and 4,280 N/T0 accepted. The post-hoc sanitizer result concerns correctness only, not deadline-qualified acceptance.
boundaries.review: A named local reviewer records a rationale bound to the exact dependency closure. The name is attributed, not identity-authenticated or institutional approval.
boundaries.scenario: Changing the A/T0 hourly price is an illustrative assumption. It does not refresh provider supply, billing terms, measured correctness or the historical H100 result.
boundaries.export: A packet retains the journal, reviews and frozen snapshots and is checked by replay and SHA-256. It is not a signed source attestation; customer-entered text travels in the export.

architecture.summary: Cantos presents the research workflow; Second Run supplies its operating methods. This page reuses two existing native owners. Adjacent estate systems retain their own authority and are not silently replaced or activated.

items.name: Research Desk / ResearchCore 1.0.0
items.role: Original journal, revision pins, dependency checks, attributed review, frozen delivery and packet replay. The source application is unchanged.

items.name: Second Run Compute
items.role: Existing quote arithmetic prices the declared allocation; the bridge relates that cost to the retained accepted count. It does not create an invoice or current offer.

items.name: Cantos workbench bridge
items.role: Connects the case, the two native owners and this interface. Scenarios require a successor and a fresh review; export retains the history.

groups.title: Existing estate capabilities, separate from this browser
groups.note: These are architectural owners and continuation paths, not claims that this page invokes every system.

items.name: Second Run shared execution
items.role: The local from_record entry can bind a retained Research Desk judgment to an exact native task and checked computation. This browser does not execute that local runner.

items.name: Genesis and Core
items.role: Genesis owns signed shard construction and verification; Core owns verified extraction and query. The local journal checksum here is not a Genesis signature.

items.name: Canon and the claim shelf
items.role: The inspected Run 3 bridge retains filed/candidate standing. Source-format checks and hashes do not grant accepted institutional standing or automatic reuse.

items.name: CAIRN-derived Knot lifecycle
items.role: The campaign implements bounded lifecycle states. Broader CAIRN federation and execution remain separate work, with no activation in this page.
